pages.text: Draw a small circle with Fiery Chalk. Offer an Athame, Netherrack, Hellebore and Charcoal. Coal is not a substitute. A damaged Athame is accepted. Cast outside Peaceful difficulty while the world is not raining.

The ritual runs for fifteen seconds, costing 1,000 starting power and 33 each second: 1,495 total, or 1,345 with Hecate's Visage. It attempts to summon two to five creatures, each chosen between a Zombified Piglin and a Magma Cube.

Each creature gets sixteen landing attempts within six blocks west/north and five east/south of the focal glyph. It searches downward for ground. Leave dry, clear, loaded space within the world border. Failed placements are skipped, so fewer creatures may appear.

One or more successful summons consumes the offerings and returns a fresh Athame. Its previous name, damage and enchantments do not transfer. If none appear, the original offerings are returned; spent power remains spent. Rain and difficulty are checked again at completion.

Summoned creatures keep their normal vanilla behavior. Magma Cube size and Piglin age/equipment use vanilla initialization. Chicken jockey creation is disabled for this ritual. Remote casting is not restored.
